## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: Sprint Phase F runs design-md-lint.sh at the equivalent enforcement point in per-worktree-review-commit.md (worktree-isolation mode) and blocks the batch on violations

## Implementation
Add enforcement step to plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md after review (Step 2) and before commit (Step 4). Runs design-md-lint.sh in the worktree context.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Enforcement step exists in per-worktree-review-commit.md referencing design-md-lint.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'design-md-lint' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Add design-md-lint.sh enforcement to per-worktree-review-commit.md
